Industrial and Commercial Bank of China.text: It was created in 1984 from the commercial banking operations of the People's Bank of China.
Industrial and Commercial Bank of China.evidence: ICBC was created on 4 January 1984 from what were then the commercial banking operations of the People's Bank of China.

Agricultural Bank of China.text: Since 1949 the bank has been formed and abolished several times; today's version dates from 1979.
Agricultural Bank of China.evidence: Since the establishment of the People's Republic of China in 1949, ABC has been formed and abolished several times. ... Today's Agricultural Bank of China was founded in February 1979.

China Construction Bank.text: Founded in 1954 as the People's Construction Bank of China, it took its current name in 1996.
China Construction Bank.evidence: CCB was founded on 1 October 1954 under the name of People's Construction Bank of China (Chinese: 中国人民建设银行; pinyin: Zhōngguó Rénmín Jiànshè Yínháng), and later changed to China Construction Bank on 26 March 1996.

Bank of China.text: Formed in 1912 from the Qing dynasty's Da-Qing Bank, it issued banknotes for the government until 1942.
Bank of China.evidence: The Bank of China was formed in 1912 by renaming the Qing dynasty's Da-Qing Bank (est. 1905) under the newly established Republican government. Until 1942, it issued banknotes on behalf of the government

JPMorgan Chase.text: Its early history traces back to 1799 and the founding of the Bank of the Manhattan Company.
JPMorgan Chase.evidence: Through its predecessors, the firm's early history can be traced to 1799, with the founding of what became the Bank of the Manhattan Company.

HSBC.text: For its original location, the founders chose Hong Kong's Wardley House for its good feng shui.
HSBC.evidence: Still, the original location of the bank was considered crucial and the founders chose Wardley House in Hong Kong since the construction was based on some of the best feng shui in colonial Hon

Bank of America.text: One root is the Bank of Italy, founded in 1904 to serve Italian immigrants who faced discrimination.
Bank of America.evidence: Another branch of its history goes back to the American-based Bank of Italy, founded by Amadeo Pietro Giannini in 1904, which provided various banking services to Italian immigrants who faced service discrimination at the time.

BNP Paribas.text: Though French, it has had the Belgian government as a significant shareholder since 2009.
BNP Paribas.evidence: Although a French banking group, the Belgian government has been a significant shareholder since 2009 (with 5.3% equity ownership as of mid-2023) as a result of the group's acquisition of Fortis Bank Belgium,

Crédit Agricole.text: Nicknamed La banque verte, 'the green bank', because of its historical ties to farming.
Crédit Agricole.evidence: sometimes called La banque verte (pronounced , lit. 'The green bank', due to its historical ties to farming), is a French international banking group and the world's largest cooperative financial institution.

Postal Savings Bank of China.text: As of 2017 it had 39,798 branches covering all regions of China.
Postal Savings Bank of China.evidence: As of 31 December 2017, PSBC has 39,798 branches covering all regions of China.
